meta.title: 画面清晰：你必须知道的要点
meta.title_en: Crisp Footage: The Key Points You Must Know

scenes.title_cn: 开场：你们问我为什么视频那么清晰？我…
scenes.title_en: Opening: you ask why my video is so crisp?…
scenes.context: 清晰度秘诀分享的开场。
sentences: 你们问我为什么我的视频那么清晰？
You ask why my videos are so crisp?
so crisp（那么清晰）
你只要按照这些简单的规则做就行了。
You just follow these simple rules.
simple rules（简单规则）
scenes.speak: You ask why my videos are so crisp? You just follow these simple rules.

scenes.title_cn: 帧率一致：我拍的是4K25帧，剪辑项…
scenes.title_en: Consistent frame rate: I shoot 4K 25fps, e…
sentences: 我拍的是4K25帧，剪辑项目也是4K25帧，但是到导出1080P 25帧。
I shoot 4K 25fps, edit in 4K 25fps, but export at 1080p 25fps.
keep it 25fps（全程25帧）
好多人拍摄30帧，剪辑25帧，导出24帧，这样不对。
Many shoot 30fps, edit 25fps, export 24fps—that's wrong.
frame rate mismatch（帧率不一致）
画面会坏掉，也会出现卡顿。
The image degrades and gets juddery.
gets juddery（出现卡顿）
scenes.speak: I shoot 4K 25fps, edit in 4K 25fps, but export at 1080p 25fps. Many shoot 30fps, edit 25fps, export 24fps—that's wrong. The image degrades and gets juddery.

scenes.title_cn: 导出1080P的原因：因为加载快，平…
scenes.title_en: Why export 1080p: it loads faster and the …
sentences: 为什么我导出1080？因为加载快，平台算法更喜欢。
Why do I export 1080p? It loads faster and the platform algorithm prefers it.
loads faster（加载快）
不管你有什么样的手机，看起来一样顺畅。
No matter your phone, it plays just as smoothly.
plays smoothly（一样顺畅）
scenes.speak: Why do I export 1080p? It loads faster and the platform algorithm prefers it. No matter your phone, it plays just as smoothly.

scenes.title_cn: 比特率误区：好多人导出时提高比特率，…
scenes.title_en: The bitrate myth: many raise the bitrate o…
scenes.context: 高比特率无益反被压更狠。
sentences: 好多人导出时提高比特率，我也不做这样，比特率不是画质。
Many raise the bitrate on export—I don't either. Bitrate isn't quality.
bitrate isn't quality（比特率不是画质）
高数据重量反而有点吃亏，平台反而压得更狠。
Heavier data loses out—the platform compresses even harder.
compresses harder（压得更狠）
光线舒服，节奏自然，有时候简单就是高级。
Comfortable light, natural rhythm—sometimes simple is premium.
simple is premium（简单即高级）
scenes.speak: Many raise the bitrate on export—I don't either. Bitrate isn't quality. Heavier data loses out—the platform compresses even harder. Comfortable light, natural rhythm—sometimes simple is premium.

practice: Shoot, edit, and export at the same frame rate.
It loads faster and the algorithm prefers it.
Bitrate isn't quality; heavy files get compressed harder.
pitfalls: Keep one frame rate across shoot, edit, and export.
帧率不一致画面会坏掉卡顿。
Export 1080p—it loads faster and the algorithm likes it.
Bitrate isn't quality; the platform compresses heavy files harder.
高比特率不是画质，反而被压得更狠。
Comfortable light and natural rhythm matter more.
光线舒服节奏自然，简单即高级。
shifts: 用 crisp（清晰）、consistent frame rate（帧率一致）、playback（播放）
用 load faster（加载快）、algorithm（算法）、juddery（卡顿）
用 bitrate（比特率）、compress harder（压得更狠）、premium（高级）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：4K25帧、1080P 25帧、30/25/24帧不一致、画面坏掉卡顿、加载快、平台算法、比特率不是画质、压得更狠、光线舒服节奏自然等。
